fragments.text: The Basel capital buffer framework comprises the capital conservation buffer (CCoB), the countercyclical capital buffer (CCyB), buffers for global systemically important banks (G-SIBs) and domestic systemically important banks (D-SIBs), and Pillar 2 buffers.
These buffers take the form of an additional layer of capital above the regulatory minimums, and must be met with Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital.
The CCyB (and any variants of it) is the only designated releasable buffer in the Basel Framework.

fragments.section_anchor: Total Loss-Absorbing Capacity (TLAC) Principles and Term Sheet
fragments.text: All G-SIB are required to meet a new requirement for Minimum External TLAC alongside minimum regulatory capital requirements set out in the Basel III framework.
